about: Decisions on near-name pairs that the automatic reconciliation set aside, read 22 November 2026. The rules in tools/setaside.py decide most pairs; these are the rest, each decided from an official page (GOV.UK or legislation.gov.uk) and carrying a short quote that tools/setaside.py --verify checks is still on that page. 'different' means two records; 'same' means one body under two names.

manual.ons: Advisory Committees on Justices of the Peace in England and Wales
manual.why: The GOV.UK record is the Ministry of Justice's committees that recommend magistrates to the Lord Chancellor, which is the England and Wales system the ONS name states.

evidence.title: GOV.UK: advisory committees on justices of the peace
evidence.quote: make recommendations to the Lord Chancellor

manual.ons: The Advisory Committee on Justices of the Peace (Northern Ireland)
manual.why: The ONS name states Northern Ireland, whose courts are run by the Northern Ireland Department of Justice; the GOV.UK record is the Ministry of Justice's committees for England and Wales.
